title: Census geography/CBP/NAICS screened with observed key gate
summary: Primary CBP API/datasets,NAICS homepage,GEOID guide and OpenData policy consulted. 2023 variable table uses NAICS2017,not2022;28 variables includeESTAB,EMP,PAYANN($1000),LFO,EMPSZES,YEAR,GEOCOMP and noise/flags. Geography county key isSTATE+COUNTY,2+3 digit strings; ZIP and ZCTA differ and vintages matter. Annual US/state/county snapshots start1986,ZIP1994. Corrected bounded API query returned HTML Missing Key; access requires review. MetadataJSON hit500k bound and was stopped. OpenData policy did not establish specific redistribution grant; copyright URL inaccessible. Needs-review on rights and credentials, no blanket federal-law inference accepted.
